inProgress=True hero=lord_6_6 npc=Yes... As you know, the wars this realm has fought have been very costly. The great lords in particular are hard-put to raise the armies that are key to this land's defense. Some of us have proposed increasing the hearth taxes paid by the peasantry, which is a key source of revenue. I don't know if this law will be approved, but rumors of it have gotten out in my district, and a lot of the farmers are restless. Now, most of us are doing their part to keep a lid on things. But there's one, Huskur, who I am ashamed to say was once a Kheshig under my banner, who's been going around the countryside, stirring up trouble. He's gathered a following and they have a whole list of demands, including a ban on new taxes, that would frankly cripple our realm's ability to raise the money needed to defend itself. I'd take care of him myself, but that wouldn't look good. Maybe you can help?
[0] clickable=True id=issue_explanation_player_response_pre_quest_solution text=Maybe. What do you need exactly?
